subject: history
concept: Understanding the Columbian Exchange: how plants, animals, and diseases moved between hemispheres
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts food/animal cards into 'came from the Americas' and 'came from Europe/Africa/Asia' piles
